evaluation_assumptions.provenance: Declared Class C planning hypotheses; not measured process times or quotations

holds: installed mass and reserve CG/inertia unknown
deck reinforcement and transverse rail-load distribution unresolved
unequal rail loading, torsion and actual bearing distribution unresolved
shear deformation, local/lateral buckling and fatigue unresolved
welds, full-moment splices, bracing and material grade unqualified
lifting, construction stages, piers, foundations and site/geotechnics unresolved
supplier/process evidence, schedule precedence and cost uncertainty unresolved

pose.name: quarter-span-moment
pose.scope: Representative ideal-beam influence pose; not a stress/deflection envelope

response.integration: two-point Gauss per cell/point-load/observation interval; cubic exact-order virtual work
response.scope: Simply supported, small-displacement, gross-elastic Euler-Bernoulli beam; prescribed piecewise constant EI, downward loads only. Excludes shear deformation, torsion, cracking, prestress, creep, dynamics, buckling, composite-action validation and physical or structural acceptance. Exact-order polynomial quadrature is subject to floating-point roundoff, not a directed-rounding numerical certificate.
response.sign_convention: positive sagging moment; shear upward on left cut face; downward deflection positive

analysis.scope: Simply supported paired girders with common curvature and symmetric load-sharing hypothesis; no composite concrete stiffness

cells.hypothesis: Nominal steel plates form longitudinal girders with common vertical curvature. The concrete deck transfers gravity without credited longitudinal composite action. Plate continuity, deck load transfer, lateral distribution, shear deformation and local/lateral stability remain unqualified. All nominal concrete dead mass is retained.

steel_only_model.hypothesis: Nominal steel plates form longitudinal girders with common vertical curvature. The concrete deck transfers gravity without credited longitudinal composite action. Plate continuity, deck load transfer, lateral distribution, shear deformation and local/lateral stability remain unqualified. All nominal concrete dead mass is retained.
